name: Satisfactory (DXMT — crashes)
notes:
DOES NOT RUN ON DXMT, AND THAT IS NOW MEASURED RATHER THAN SUSPECTED. Re-tested 13 Sep 2026: the 5 Aug rejection is CONFIRMED, not overturned. Use the `satisfactory` (D3DMetal) profile to play. Do not re-run this to find out; re-run it only if the mechanism below changes.

WHAT WAS MEASURED, 13 Sep 2026, Apple M4, macOS 26.5.1 (25F80). `wyn play satisfactory-dxmt` -> steam.exe -applaunch 526870, Wyn printing "Graphics layer: DXMT". The game reached D3D11 init and died about one second later: RHIThread crash, `Assertion failed: IsSet() [Optional.h:362]`, callstack TOptional<FD3D11DynamicRHI::FTimestampCalibration>::operator->() -> FD3D11DynamicRHI::PollQueryResults() [D3D11Query.cpp:301]. No menu, no map, no frames. It is a startup crash, not a black screen and not a hang.

AND IT REALLY WAS DXMT THIS TIME, which is exactly what the August run could not show. Three independent checks agreed: the log's `Chosen D3D11 Adapter` block reads Apple M4 / VendorId 106b (D3DMetal reads AMD Compatibility Mode / 1002); lsof on the live FactoryGameSteam-Win64-Shipping.exe mapped winemetal.so, winemetal.so.aot and winemetal.dll and NO libd3dshared.dylib; and wyn play reported the layer itself. The DXMT payload at Libraries.dxmt-wine11.0/DXMT/x64 is native PE at offset 0x40, so the -Dwine_builtin_dll=true hazard that made the August result untrustworthy does not apply to this run.

THE MECHANISM IS A DXMT CAPABILITY GAP, NOT A SATISFACTORY BUG. DXMT does not supply timestamp calibration, so UE's D3D11 query path dereferences an unset TOptional the first time it polls. What would change this answer: DXMT answering GetTimestampCalibration, or UE tolerating its absence. Re-test then, and not before.

STALE PER-EXE OVERRIDES DID NOT FAKE THIS. The bottle carries AppDefaults\factorygame*.exe\DllOverrides with atidxx64, d3d10, d3d11, d3d12 and dxgi all "=b", left by past D3DMetal runs. solarpunk.exe carries the identical set and still measured as true DXMT on 6 Sep, so this profile's WINEDLLOVERRIDES=dxgi,d3d11,d3d10core=n,b wins over the registry. Environment beats AppDefaults on this stack; that is why the layer can be chosen per launch without rewriting the bottle.

TWO LOGS LIVE IN THIS PREFIX AND THE WRONG ONE WILL MISLEAD YOU. drive_c/users/crossover/AppData/Local/FactoryGame/Saved/Logs/FactoryGame.log is stale - its last entry is 12 Sep, the MallocBinned2 quit-crash that belongs to the D3DMetal profile. The live one is under drive_c/users/ebenoelofse/. `wyn play` flags the stale one before launching; believe it.

ORIGINAL 5 AUG NOTE, NOW CONFIRMED: DXMT loads Apple M4 FL11_1 then RHIThread assert TOptional<FTimestampCalibration> unset (UE D3D11RHI), Factory Crash Reporter. It was measured against the June DXMT, whose DLLs were built with meson's wine_builtin_dll default of true - stamped "Wine builtin DLL" at offset 0x40, which makes Wine's load_builtin() rewrite =n,b into =b,n and hand back D3DMetal - so it demanded a re-test before being trusted. The re-test agrees with it. Solarpunk failed the same way in June and then ran clean on a v0.80 build made with -Dwine_builtin_dll=false (6 Sep, see solarpunk-dxmt); that recovery does not generalise to this title.
